name: orientation
wording: what every session on a host with cratylus installed knows of it from its start, launched as an agent or as none: what cratylus is for, that using it starts by launching the architect, and that its theory is cratylic context design; stated once by the cratylus command describing itself; answered at the level asked, the theory only when asked why, and making one's own agents never offered as how to use it
reason: A newcomer's plain session, asked how to use cratylus, had nothing that said what it is: it searched skills and source, opened with Plato, and gave authoring as the first step.
